props.title: Tejas Singh
props.face: Covers as a duo, a trio or a full band.
props.lede: It’s a lot of fun to watch a song you love come together one guitar part at a time. Tejas Singh builds it live with a looper, a device that repeats what he’s just played, until it sounds like the whole record is playing behind his voice. You can start with a duo for dinner and have the full band join him for the dance floor.
props.headingNote: We can fit the music to your event, including how many musicians play, which songs they choose and what they wear. Here’s how booking through Signet works.

props.title: Tejas Singh live for Sofar Sounds

props.html: This is the act to book when you want one singer for your whole event. Whether Tejas is performing as a duo, as a trio or with the full band, you get sophisticated covers of your guests’ favorite songs, and his own singer-songwriter material when you want it.
As a quartet, he’s got a real dance band, with bass and drums behind him, plus keys or a second guitar.

props.title: Configurations
props.note: Not sure which size you need? Send us the date and we’ll help you choose.

rows.text: The quartet is perfect for a company party with a dance floor, and it can play a downtown Denver ballroom or your own office.
As a duo, Tejas can keep the same songs quiet enough for easy conversation, and that’s just right for a client dinner or a member event. If you only need an hour, we can do that, too.
He’s a great pick for a milestone birthday or an anniversary, especially if you’re planning dinner and then dancing.
The duo gives you a singer for the hour after the ceremony, and it’s a great choice when you want songs everyone knows.

props.html: Got speeches or a program? We can plan the music around them with your run of show. Curious about prices? Our cost guide lays out what live music costs across Colorado.

items.a: He mostly plays covers, and they reach right up to the songs of the last twenty years.
As a duo, it's pretty soft. The quartet plays about as loud as a band at a good party. The band can turn up or down to suit your venue, so if there's a sound limit, just let us know.

items.q: Can we ask for a song?
items.a: Yes. If there’s a song that isn’t on his list, such as your first dance, just tell us when you book and he can usually learn it.
